cn2.text: Ghirapur is alive with the Inventors' Fair, where automatons hawk attractions to Rashmi and Mitul, but every shop in the city turns out to be out of the filament they need, and Rashmi sadly tells Mitul they must close the inquirium.

Saheeli spends the night in automaton duels at the arena, then reveals she bought Padeem's audience with a front-row duel seat, and she and Rashmi reconcile before presenting the transporter to Padeem.
Chandra planeswalks back to the city for the first time since she left, hunting a renegade inventor, and Liliana persuades her to celebrate her return even as they search.

After they flee a Consulate soldier and Chandra blames an officer named Baral for her parents' deaths, they chase an aether disruption and find a woman with hair like Chandra's, whom Tezzeret calls Renegade Prime.

kld.text: Ghirapur is the city of wonders that was founded on neutral ground after the War of Eleven, when eleven inventors became the first Consulate.
At the Inventors' Fair, the Consulate's month-long exposition, Tezzeret steals Rashmi's matter transporter to make a Planar Bridge and Pia and Chandra Nalaar are arrested.
Chandra drops her disguise to save Pia from Tezzeret's attack, and while Consulate enforcers seize the submitted inventions as the crowd flees, Pia surrenders to protect her daughter.
Oviya Pashiri takes Chandra and Nissa under her protection, promising to rescue Pia, and Ajani and the Gatewatch free prisoners and confront Tezzeret, igniting open conflict.

aer.text: In Ghirapur, Pia Nalaar mourns that the Consulate has seized the inventors' workshops and creations, and the renegades revolt, seizing large parts of the city to overthrow the Consulate.
The Consulate answers with martial law, automaton soldiers and a secret police, yet defections grow and the Renegades swell in number, armed with quicksmith armor and plated airships.

The Gatewatch and renegades confront Tezzeret at the Aether Spire, where Saheeli and Pia build the thopter Hope of Ghirapur and Chandra volunteers to use her fire as a detonator, helping destroy Tezzeret's planar bridge.
After Tezzeret's final defeat the Consulate yields, Pia becomes consul of Allocation and Baral is imprisoned, and Chandra says a tearful farewell to her mother and home.

dft.text: Ghirapur hosts the Grand Prix, whose winner will claim the Aetherspark, and Gonti fires the flare that sends the racers surging off the line with Chandra in last place.

Pia gives Spitfire a new aether-powered racing suit, and Spitfire races through the Omenpath into Ghirapur, leading the field until a golden filigree wall rises ahead of the finish line and she crashes into it.
Half of her mask falls away, revealing her to the guards as Sita, and her father Mohar orders his men to keep it secret.
Then Jace, flanked by the Consulate's goons with Vraska at his side, uses a spell to turn the wrecked racers on Chandra, and guards seize Pia and hold a blade to her throat.
Sita breaks free to save Pia and fights beside her and Chandra as Team Avishkar, but Jace takes Loot and leaves.
